messages:
alex: quick heads-up — found an SDK vs REST parity issue around async embeddings. REST returns 202 + Location header and works fine, but the Go SDK treats any non-200 as error and triggers our retry middleware, creating duplicate jobs. repro below.

alex: curl repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async \\\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\\
  -d '{\"model\":\"embed-lite\",\"input\":[\"x\",\"y\"]}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
# -> Location: /v1/jobs/zz99aa
```

alex: go-sdk repro (simplified):
```
job, err := client.Embeddings.CreateAsync(ctx, CreateAsyncParams{Model: "embed-lite", Input: []string{"x","y"}})
if err != nil { /* library retries and resends */ }
// ends up with duplicate jobs in billing
```

toni: thanks, alex. looks like same root cause as the python report last week — our http wrapper is too strict. in go we used `if resp.StatusCode != 200`. should accept any 2xx and surface Location header as job id.

toni: proposal: update http/response.go to treat 200-299 as success; return a Response object that includes Headers map so higher-level APIs can capture Location. add unit test that returns 202 + Location and asserts no retry.

raj: adding customer impact — support flagged a customer whose daily job count doubled. suggest hotfix for go + node + python. also add a tiny e2e in onboarding-sampleapp CI that calls the async embeddings endpoint using the SDK, so we catch parity regressions.

alex: agree on rollout: patch -> release hotfix for go -> update node & python if not already fixed -> notify support to reconcile duplicates -> add e2e.

toni: opening PR with test + changelog. tagging @devex-bot to create SDK issue and track releases.

devex-bot: Created issue #3610: "go-sdk: accept 2xx for async endpoints and expose Location header to prevent duplicate async jobs" assigned to toni, priority: high. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3610 :white_check_mark:
